## XpmActions.size property

The number of actions in the collection.

**Signature:**

```typescript
get size(): number;
```

## Remarks

This value is known only after `initialise()`<!-- -->.

This getter provides direct access to the collection size, enabling callers to check for emptiness or iterate with knowledge of the collection's extent.
